title: Login with valid credentials
description: Test successful user login. Navigate to the login page, fill email and password with valid credentials, submit the form, and verify the user reaches an authenticated state.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL (homepage)
Click the Login or Sign In navigation link to reach the login page
Fill the email or username field with testuser@example.com
Fill the password field with TestPass123!
Click the Sign In or Login submit button
Wait for page to load after form submission
Assert that a heading or element confirming authenticated state is visible (My Account, Order History, or dashboard heading)
assertions: A logged-in state heading or dashboard should be visible after submission
The login form should no longer be present
User-specific navigation (My Account, Orders, Logout) should appear
notes: Always use testuser@example.com and TestPass123! as test credentials. Assert on the heading of the post-login page.

title: Login with invalid credentials
description: Test login rejection with wrong credentials. Fill in an incorrect email or password and verify an error message is shown instead of granting access.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Login navigation link
Fill the email field with wrong@example.com
Fill the password field with WrongPass999
Click the Sign In button
Wait for page to load
Assert that an error message is visible indicating login failure
assertions: An error or alert message should be visible indicating login failure
The user should remain on the login page (not redirected to dashboard)
notes: For invalid credential tests, assert on error messages, not on successful landing pages.

title: New user registration
description: Test creating a new user account. Navigate to the registration page, fill all required fields with valid data, submit, and verify the account was created.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Sign Up or Register link
Fill the name or full name field with Test User
Fill the email field with newuser@example.com
Fill the password field with TestPass123!
Fill the confirm password field with TestPass123! if present
Click the Register or Create Account button
Wait for page to load
Assert a confirmation heading is visible (Welcome, Account Created, or dashboard)
assertions: A success message or welcome heading should be visible after registration
The user should be redirected away from the registration form
notes: Use unique-looking email values like newuser@example.com. Confirm password fields need the same value as password.

title: Registration form validation
description: Test registration form validation. Submit the form with missing or mismatched fields and verify appropriate validation errors appear.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Sign Up or Register link
Leave required fields empty or fill password with TestPass123! and confirm password with DifferentPass456
Click the Register button without filling all fields
Wait for validation response
Assert that validation error messages are visible
assertions: Validation error messages should appear for empty or invalid fields
The form should not be submitted successfully with invalid data
notes: Focus assertions on error messages and the form remaining visible after failed submission.

title: User logout flow
description: Test the logout flow. After navigating to the app, click the logout button and verify the user is returned to an unauthenticated state.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Login link to log in first
Fill credentials and sign in
After login, click the Logout button or link
Wait for page to load
Assert that the login page or heading confirming logged-out state is visible
assertions: Login or Sign In option should reappear after logout
Account-specific navigation (My Account, Orders) should be gone
notes: The Logout button may be in a dropdown menu. After logout, assert visibility of the Login link or heading.

title: Forgot password / password reset request
description: Test the forgot password flow. Navigate to the login page, click the forgot password link, enter an email address, and verify a confirmation message is shown.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Login link
Click the Forgot Password? link on the login page
Fill the email field with testuser@example.com
Click the submit or send button
Wait for page to load
Assert that a confirmation message is visible
assertions: A confirmation message about the password reset email should be visible
No error messages should appear for a valid email
notes: The Forgot Password link is usually on the login page. Assertions should target the success/confirmation message.

title: Session persistence and timeout
description: Test session behavior. Verify that the user remains authenticated across navigation or gets redirected to login when the session expires.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click Login and sign in with testuser@example.com and TestPass123!
After login, navigate to My Account or Order History
Assert the user is still authenticated on the new page
Assert that account-specific content is visible
assertions: User should remain authenticated when navigating between pages
Account page headings (My Account, Order History) should be visible
notes: For session timeout tests, assert that unauthenticated navigation redirects to the login page.

title: Change password from account settings
description: Test changing the account password from within the user account settings page. Enter the current password, set a new one, and verify the change is accepted.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click Login and sign in with testuser@example.com and TestPass123!
Navigate to My Account or Account Settings
Find the change password section
Fill the current password field with TestPass123!
Fill the new password field with NewPass456!
Fill the confirm new password field with NewPass456!
Click Save or Update Password
Assert that My Account heading is still visible (update succeeded)
assertions: A success message or the My Account heading should be visible after password change
No error messages should appear for valid matching passwords
notes: Requires being logged in first. Assert on success message or page heading after submission.

title: Update user profile information
description: Test updating user profile information such as name or email from the account settings page.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click Login and sign in with testuser@example.com and TestPass123!
Click on My Account or Profile link
Fill the Full Name or name field with Updated User
Click Save Changes or Update Profile
Wait for page to load
Assert that My Account heading is visible (update succeeded)
assertions: My Account heading should remain visible after updating
A success or confirmation message may appear
notes: Profile update requires authentication first. Assert on the page heading or success confirmation after save.

title: Basic product search
description: Test the product search functionality. Enter a search term in the search input, submit, and verify search results are shown.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Fill the search input field with a relevant search term (e.g., laptop)
Click the Search button or press submit
Wait for the results page to load
Assert that a results heading or product listing is visible
assertions: A results heading (All Products, Search Results) should be visible
Product cards or items matching the search term should appear
notes: Extract the search term from the user request. If none specified, use laptop as the default search term.

title: Search with no results
description: Test search behavior when no products match the query. Search for a term that returns no results and verify the empty state is handled correctly.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Fill the search input with a term that returns no results (e.g., xyznonexistentproduct123)
Click the Search button
Wait for page to load
Assert that a no-results message or empty state indicator is visible
assertions: An empty state message (No products found, No results) should be visible
No product cards should appear in the results
notes: Use obviously non-matching search terms. Assert on the empty state message text.

title: Search then sort results
description: Test searching for products and then sorting the results. Enter a search term, get results, then apply a sort order.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Fill the search input with laptop
Click the Search button
Wait for results to load
Select an option from the Sort by dropdown
Wait for results to reorder
Assert that the All Products heading is visible
assertions: All Products heading should remain visible after sorting
Products should be reordered according to the sort selection
notes: Search first, then apply sorting. Assert on the results heading remaining visible.

title: Filter products by category
description: Test filtering products by category. Navigate to the products page, select or click a category filter, and verify only products from that category are shown.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products navigation link to go to the products page
Click a category link or select from the category filter (e.g., Laptops, Smartphones)
Wait for the filtered results to load
Assert that the products heading or category heading is visible
assertions: A category-specific heading or filtered products heading should be visible
Products shown should match the selected category
notes: Category links are often in the sidebar or navigation. Use available category link names from the page elements.

title: Sort products by price or name
description: Test product sorting functionality. Navigate to the products page, use the sort dropdown to change the order, and verify the products are reordered.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products navigation link
Find the Sort by dropdown or select element
Select a sort option (Sort by Price, Sort by Name)
Wait for the page to reload with sorted results
Assert that the products heading is still visible
assertions: The products list should still be visible after sorting
All Products or a similar heading should be visible
notes: Sort is usually a combobox/select element. Use the Sort by element from available page elements.

title: Filter products by price range
description: Test filtering products by a price range. Navigate to the products page, set a price range filter, and verify products outside that range are excluded.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products navigation link
Look for a price range filter in the sidebar (Price Range heading)
Click or interact with the price range controls
Wait for results to update
Assert that the All Products heading is visible
assertions: All Products heading should remain visible
Products displayed should fall within the selected price range
notes: Price range filters may use sliders or input fields. Assert on the heading after filtering.

title: Apply multiple filters together
description: Test applying multiple filters simultaneously. Select a category filter AND a sort order, then verify the results reflect both constraints.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products navigation link
Click a category link (e.g., Laptops)
Wait for the first filter to apply
Select a sort option from the Sort by dropdown
Wait for the combined results to load
Assert that the All Products heading is visible
assertions: All Products heading should be visible after applying multiple filters
Results should reflect both the category and sort selections
notes: Apply filters sequentially. Assert on the heading after all filters are applied.

title: Clear all active filters
description: Test clearing all active filters to return to the unfiltered product listing.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products navigation link
Click a category filter to activate it
Wait for filtered results
Click the Clear All or Reset Filters button
Wait for the full product list to restore
Assert that the All Products heading is visible
assertions: All Products heading should be visible after clearing filters
The full product catalog should be restored
notes: Clear All button is usually near the active filter chips. Assert on the full products heading.

title: Add product to shopping cart
description: Test adding a product to the cart. From the products page or home page, click Add to Cart and verify the cart is updated.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link to view the products page
Click the Add to Cart button for a product
Wait for page to load (cart may update without navigation)
Click the Shopping Cart link to view the cart
Wait for cart page to load
Assert that the Shopping Cart heading is visible
assertions: Shopping Cart heading should be visible after navigating to cart
Cart should show at least one item
notes: After clicking Add to Cart, navigate to the cart page to verify. The cart link is usually in the navigation.

title: Remove item from shopping cart
description: Test removing an item from the shopping cart. Navigate to the cart page and click the Remove button to delete an item.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Shopping Cart link to go to the cart page
Click the Remove button next to an item
Wait for the cart to update
Assert the Shopping Cart heading is still visible
assertions: After removing, the Shopping Cart page should still be visible
The Shopping Cart heading should remain visible
notes: The Remove button is typically in the cart item row. Navigate to cart first before attempting removal.

title: Update cart item quantity
description: Test updating the quantity of an item in the cart. Navigate to the cart, use the quantity controls to change the amount, and verify the cart updates.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Shopping Cart link
Click the + or Increase Quantity button to increase the item quantity
Wait for the cart to update
Assert the Shopping Cart heading and Order Summary are visible
assertions: Shopping Cart heading should remain visible
Order Summary should be visible showing updated totals
notes: Quantity controls are typically + and - buttons in the cart. The cart total should update automatically.

title: Prevent negative quantity in cart
description: Test that cart quantity cannot be set below 1 or become negative. Click the decrease button repeatedly and verify the quantity floor is enforced.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Shopping Cart link
If cart is empty, go to Products and click Add to Cart first
On the cart page, click the - or Decrease Quantity button multiple times
Wait after each click
Assert that the Shopping Cart heading is visible and quantity does not go negative
assertions: Shopping Cart heading should remain visible
The quantity should not drop below 1 — the - button should be disabled or stop at 1
Order Summary should still be visible
notes: Click the decrease button until it stops responding. The quantity minimum should be 1 (item stays in cart) or the item gets removed at 0.

title: Empty cart state and checkout redirect
description: Test the empty cart state. Navigate to the cart when it has no items and verify the empty state is shown correctly.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Shopping Cart link
Assert that the Shopping Cart heading is visible
If cart shows empty state, assert the Continue Shopping or Products link is visible
assertions: Shopping Cart heading should be visible when on the cart page
An empty cart message or Continue Shopping prompt may be visible
notes: For empty cart, assert visibility of the cart page heading. The checkout button may be disabled or hidden.

title: Cart with multiple different items
description: Test the shopping cart with multiple different items. Add multiple products and verify the cart handles them correctly.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link
Click Add to Cart for the first product
Click Add to Cart for another product
Click the Shopping Cart link
Wait for cart page to load
Assert the Shopping Cart and Order Summary headings are visible
assertions: Shopping Cart heading should be visible
Order Summary should be visible showing combined totals
notes: Add multiple items by clicking Add to Cart multiple times before navigating to the cart.

title: Cart persistence after login
description: Test that items added to the cart as a guest are preserved after the user logs in.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL without logging in
Click Products and click Add to Cart for a product
Navigate to the cart and verify the item is there
Click the Login link and sign in with testuser@example.com and TestPass123!
Navigate to the Shopping Cart after login
Assert the Shopping Cart heading is visible
assertions: Shopping Cart heading should be visible after logging in
Cart items should persist across the login transition
notes: Add items as guest first, then log in and verify cart. This tests session merging behavior.

title: Checkout shipping information
description: Test filling in shipping information during checkout. Navigate to checkout, fill the shipping address form, and proceed to the next step.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Shopping Cart or Checkout link
Fill the Full Name field with Test User
Fill the Email field with testuser@example.com
Fill the Address field with 123 Test Street
Fill the City field with New York
Fill the State field with NY
Fill the ZIP Code field with 10001
Click the Continue button
Wait for page to load
Assert the Checkout heading is visible
assertions: Checkout heading should be visible throughout the process
After clicking Continue, the next step should load
notes: Use realistic US address data. Fill fields in the order they appear. The Continue button moves to payment.

title: Checkout payment information
description: Test filling payment details during checkout. Fill card number, expiry date, and CVV fields and verify the payment step completes.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Shopping Cart or Checkout link
Fill the Card Number field with 4111111111111111
Fill the Expiry Date field with 12/28
Fill the CVV field with 123
Click Place Order or Continue button
Wait for page to load
Assert the Checkout heading is visible
assertions: Checkout heading should remain visible
After submitting payment, an order confirmation may appear
notes: Use Visa test card 4111111111111111. Expiry: 12/28, CVV: 123. Place Order is the final checkout button.

title: Complete end-to-end checkout flow
description: Test the complete checkout flow from cart to order confirmation. Fill shipping, then payment details, place the order, and verify confirmation.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Shopping Cart link
Click Proceed to Checkout button
Fill the Full Name with Test User
Fill the Email with testuser@example.com
Fill the Address with 123 Test Street
Fill the City with New York
Fill the ZIP Code with 10001
Click Continue to move to payment
Fill the Card Number with 4111111111111111
Fill the Expiry Date with 12/28
Fill the CVV with 123
Click Place Order
Wait for confirmation page to load
Assert the Checkout heading is visible
assertions: Order confirmation or success heading should appear after placing the order
Checkout heading should be visible throughout the process
notes: This is a multi-step flow. Fill shipping first, then payment. Use test card 4111111111111111.

title: Checkout form validation errors
description: Test checkout form validation. Submit the checkout form without filling required fields and verify that appropriate validation errors appear.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Shopping Cart link
Click Proceed to Checkout
Leave required fields empty and click Continue
Wait for validation errors to appear
Assert that the Checkout heading is still visible
assertions: Validation error messages should appear for empty required fields
The Checkout heading should still be visible — user stays on checkout page
notes: For validation tests, do NOT fill the required fields. Click submit immediately and assert on error messages.

title: Guest checkout without account
description: Test completing checkout without being logged in as a guest. Verify the checkout flow is accessible to unauthenticated users.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL without logging in first
Click Products link and add a product to cart
Click the Shopping Cart link
Click Proceed to Checkout
Fill the Full Name with Guest User
Fill the Email with guest@example.com
Fill the Address with 456 Guest Avenue
Fill the City with Boston
Fill the ZIP Code with 02101
Click Continue
Assert the Checkout heading is visible
assertions: Checkout should be accessible without being logged in
Checkout heading should be visible
notes: Do not log in before starting this test. Guest checkout should not require an account.

title: Prevent double order submission
description: Test that clicking Place Order multiple times does not create duplicate orders. Click the button once and verify the UI prevents a second submission.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Navigate through the checkout process filling required fields
Fill the Card Number with 4111111111111111
Fill the Expiry Date with 12/28
Fill the CVV with 123
Click Place Order
Wait for page to load
Assert the Checkout heading is visible — the button should have been disabled after first click
assertions: Checkout heading should be visible after the order is placed
The Place Order button should be disabled or hidden after first submission
notes: Click Place Order once. The UI should disable the button immediately after first click to prevent double submission.

title: Product detail page
description: Test viewing a product detail page. Click on a product card from the listing and verify the product detail page loads with the correct information.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link to view all products
Click on a product card (e.g., MacBook Air M2) to open the detail page
Wait for the product detail page to load
Assert that a product heading or the All Products heading is visible
assertions: Product heading or name should be visible on the detail page
Add to Cart button should be present on the product detail page
notes: Click on a specific product card name from the available gridItems or cards in the page elements.

title: Out of stock product handling
description: Test how the application handles out-of-stock products. Verify that unavailable products show an appropriate indicator and prevent adding to cart.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link
Look for an out-of-stock product indicator (Out of Stock button or label)
Click on the out-of-stock product or its indicator
Wait for the page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: Out of stock products should show an indicator (disabled button, Sold Out label)
The All Products heading should remain visible
notes: The Out of Stock button is typically disabled. Assert on its visibility, not on adding to cart.

title: Wishlist operations
description: Test adding a product to the wishlist. Navigate to a product, click the wishlist button, and verify the item is saved.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link
Click on a product card to view the product detail
Look for a wishlist, heart, or Save button
Click Add to Cart as a fallback if no wishlist button is visible
Wait for page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: All Products heading should be visible
Wishlist button state should change (filled heart, Saved) if wishlist feature exists
notes: Wishlist may not exist in all apps. If unavailable, fall back to asserting the product detail page is visible.

title: Compare products side by side
description: Test the product comparison feature. Select multiple products for comparison and verify the comparison view is shown.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link
Click on a product card
Wait for product detail page to load
Click Add to Cart as the primary interaction
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: All Products heading should be visible
Products should be accessible for selection and comparison
notes: If the app lacks a comparison feature, test that navigating between products works correctly.

title: Home page navigation and content
description: Test the home page loads correctly with all key sections visible. Verify the main heading, navigation, and featured content are present.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load
Assert that the main heading is visible (Welcome to TechStore or equivalent)
Verify navigation links (Products, Cart, Login) are present
assertions: Welcome to TechStore or main heading should be visible
Navigation links should be present and visible
notes: Home page tests assert on the main welcome heading. Use the first heading from available headings.

title: Category navigation flow
description: Test navigating to product categories via navigation links. Click a category link and verify the correct products are shown.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click a category link (Laptops, Smartphones, Audio, Tablets, or Gaming)
Wait for the category products to load
Assert that the All Products heading or a category-specific heading is visible
assertions: All Products or category heading should be visible after navigation
Products matching the selected category should be displayed
notes: Category links are usually in the navigation sidebar or top nav. Use link names from available page elements.

title: Basic page navigation
description: Test navigation between main pages of the application. Click navigation links and verify the correct pages load.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for the page to load
Assert the main heading is visible (Welcome to TechStore or similar)
assertions: The main page heading should be visible after navigation
Navigation links (Products, Cart, Login) should be visible in the header
notes: For navigate tests, assert visibility of the page heading after navigation.

title: Invalid route / 404 error handling
description: Test how the application handles navigation to an invalid URL. Verify that a 404 or not-found page is shown.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load
Assert the main page heading is visible (the app handles the route gracefully)
assertions: The application should show either a 404 page or redirect to the homepage
The main heading should be visible
notes: For 404 tests, assert what the user sees after the invalid navigation — an error page or a homepage redirect.

title: Pagination through product pages
description: Test navigating through multiple pages of product listings using pagination controls.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products navigation link
Wait for the products page to load
Click the page 2 button or the next page pagination control
Wait for the next page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: All Products heading should remain visible on page 2
Different products should be shown on the second page
notes: Pagination buttons are labeled with page numbers (1, 2, ...) or Next/Previous. Use the number buttons from available page elements.

title: View order history
description: Test viewing the user's order history. Log in, navigate to the account section, and verify past orders are displayed.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click Login and sign in with testuser@example.com and TestPass123!
Click the My Account or Orders link
Wait for the order history page to load
Assert that the Order History or My Account heading is visible
assertions: Order History or My Account heading should be visible
Past orders (or an empty state) should be shown
notes: Order history requires authentication. Assert on the Order History heading after navigation.

title: Account section navigation
description: Test navigating through the account section including profile, orders, and settings.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click Login and sign in with testuser@example.com and TestPass123!
Click the My Account link
Wait for the account page to load
Assert that the My Account heading is visible
assertions: My Account heading should be visible after navigating to the account section
Account sub-sections (Orders, Profile, Settings) should be accessible
notes: Account navigation requires authentication. Assert on the My Account heading.

title: Admin dashboard login and access
description: Test admin user login and access to the admin dashboard. Log in with admin credentials and verify access to the Admin Dashboard.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Login link
Fill the email field with admin@example.com
Fill the password field with AdminPass123!
Click the Sign In button
Wait for page to load
Assert the Admin Dashboard heading is visible
assertions: Admin Dashboard heading should be visible after admin login
Admin-specific controls (Add Product, Orders management) should be accessible
notes: Use admin@example.com and AdminPass123! for admin credentials. The Admin Dashboard heading should appear after login.

title: Admin product management
description: Test admin product management features. Access the admin dashboard and test adding, editing, or deleting a product.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Login link and sign in with admin credentials
Navigate to the Admin Dashboard
Click the Add Product button
Wait for the form to load
Assert the Admin Dashboard heading is visible
assertions: Admin Dashboard heading should be visible
Add Product button should be present in the admin interface
notes: Admin product management requires admin login first. Assert on Admin Dashboard heading.

title: Admin add new product
description: Test the admin form for adding a new product. Fill in product details and submit the add product form.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click Login and sign in with admin credentials (admin@example.com / AdminPass123!)
Navigate to the Admin Dashboard
Click the Add Product button
Fill the product name field with Test Product
Fill the product price field with 99.99
Click the Save or Submit button
Wait for page to load
Assert the Admin Dashboard heading is visible
assertions: Admin Dashboard heading should be visible after adding the product
A success message or the new product may appear in the product list
notes: Admin add product requires admin authentication. Fill product name and price at minimum.

title: Admin order management
description: Test admin order management. Navigate to the admin area and verify orders can be viewed and managed.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click Login and sign in with admin credentials
Navigate to the Admin Dashboard
Assert the Admin Dashboard heading is visible
assertions: Admin Dashboard heading should be visible
Order management section should be accessible from the dashboard
notes: Admin order management requires admin authentication. Assert on the Admin Dashboard heading.

title: Responsive navbar and mobile menu
description: Test the responsive navigation bar. Verify that navigation links are visible and functional across different viewport sizes.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load
Assert that the main navigation links are visible (Products, Shopping Cart, Login)
Click the Products navigation link
Wait for the products page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: Navigation links should be visible in the header
All Products heading should appear after clicking the Products link
notes: For responsive navbar tests, assert on the visibility of navigation links and their functionality.

title: Toast notification system
description: Test the toast notification system. Trigger an action that shows a toast notification and verify the notification appears.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link
Click the Add to Cart button for a product
Wait for the toast notification to appear
Assert the Shopping Cart heading or a confirmation is visible
assertions: A toast notification or success message should appear after the action
The page should show confirmation of the action (Shopping Cart heading or item count update)
notes: Toast notifications are transient. Assert on the result of the action rather than the toast itself.

title: Modal dialog functionality
description: Test modal dialog behavior. Trigger a modal to open, interact with it, and verify it can be closed.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link to view products
Click on a product card to open detail or modal
Wait for the detail page or modal to load
Assert the All Products heading or a product heading is visible
assertions: The product detail content should be visible after clicking a product
All Products or product name heading should be visible
notes: Modals may open on product click. If the app navigates instead, assert on the page heading.

title: Loading states and spinners
description: Test that loading states appear correctly during page transitions and data fetching. Verify that pages load to their completed state.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load completely
Assert that the main heading is visible (Welcome to TechStore)
Click the Products link
Wait for the products page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: Pages should fully load without stuck loading spinners
Main content headings should become visible after navigation
notes: Loading states should resolve. The waitForLoad step handles page transitions. Assert on the final loaded state heading.

title: Image lazy loading
description: Test that images load correctly, including lazily-loaded images that appear when scrolling into view.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load
Assert the main heading is visible (Welcome to TechStore)
Click the Products link
Wait for the products page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: All Products heading should be visible after navigation
Product images should be visible when the page loads
notes: For lazy loading tests, assert on page headings and product visibility. The browser handles lazy loading automatically.

title: Page load time performance
description: Test page load performance. Navigate to key pages and verify they load within acceptable time by asserting on the presence of page headings.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load
Assert the main heading is visible (Welcome to TechStore)
Click the Products link
Wait for the products page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: Welcome to TechStore heading should be visible on the homepage
All Products heading should be visible on the products page
notes: For performance tests, use waitForLoad to gate assertions. If the page heading is visible, the page loaded successfully.

title: Accessibility verification
description: Test basic accessibility of the application. Verify that key page elements have accessible names and that navigation is possible.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load
Assert the main heading is visible (Welcome to TechStore)
Click the Products navigation link
Wait for page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: Headings should be present and visible on every page
Navigation links should be present and clickable
Form fields should have accessible names
notes: Accessibility tests use standard navigation patterns. Headings, links, and buttons should all have visible and accessible names.

title: API error handling
description: Test how the application handles API errors. Verify that error states are communicated gracefully to the user.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load
Assert the main heading is visible (Welcome to TechStore)
Click the Products link
Wait for page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: The main heading should be visible — app renders without crashing
All Products heading should be visible on the products page
notes: For API error tests, verify the app shows a user-friendly state rather than crashing. Assert on the visible headings.

title: Cross-device data synchronization
description: Test that user data (cart, account) is consistent across sessions. Log in and verify the account state is synchronized.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click Login and sign in with testuser@example.com and TestPass123!
Navigate to My Account or Shopping Cart
Wait for page to load
Assert the My Account or Shopping Cart heading is visible
assertions: My Account or Shopping Cart heading should be visible
Account data should be accessible and consistent after login
notes: Cross-device sync is tested by verifying the logged-in state and data consistency. Assert on account page headings.

title: Multi-browser and cross-browser testing
description: Test that the application works correctly across different browsers. Navigate through key flows and verify consistent behavior.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Wait for page to load
Assert the main heading is visible (Welcome to TechStore)
Click Products link
Wait for products page to load
Assert the All Products heading is visible
assertions: Welcome to TechStore heading should be visible on the homepage
All Products heading should be visible on the products page
notes: Cross-browser tests use the same navigation patterns as regular tests. Assert on standard headings and elements.

title: Full end-to-end shopping journey
description: Test the complete shopping journey from browsing to order completion. Browse products, add to cart, login, checkout, and verify order confirmation.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link and browse products
Click Add to Cart for a product
Click the Shopping Cart link
Click Proceed to Checkout
Fill the Full Name with Test User
Fill the Email with testuser@example.com
Fill the Address with 123 Test Street
Fill the City with New York
Fill the ZIP Code with 10001
Click Continue
Fill the Card Number with 4111111111111111
Fill the Expiry Date with 12/28
Fill the CVV with 123
Click Place Order
Assert the Checkout heading is visible
assertions: Checkout heading should be visible throughout the process
Order confirmation should appear after Place Order
notes: This is a full multi-step journey. Fill each section completely before moving on. Use realistic test data throughout.

title: Browse, filter, and purchase flow
description: Test the journey from browsing and filtering products through to purchase. Apply filters, select a product, and complete the purchase.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Click the Products link
Click a category link (e.g., Laptops) to filter
Wait for filtered results to load
Click Add to Cart for a product
Click the Shopping Cart link
Click Proceed to Checkout
Fill the Full Name with Test User
Fill the Email with testuser@example.com
Fill the City with New York
Fill the ZIP Code with 10001
Click Continue
Fill the Card Number with 4111111111111111
Fill the Expiry Date with 12/28
Fill the CVV with 123
Click Place Order
Assert the Checkout heading is visible
assertions: Checkout heading should be visible after placing the order
The flow should complete without errors
notes: This journey combines filtering, cart, and checkout. Complete each step before proceeding.

title: Form field validation
description: Test generic form validation. Submit a form with invalid or missing data and verify that validation error messages are shown.
stepGuidance: Navigate to the start URL
Navigate to a page with a form (Login, Register, or Checkout)
Click the submit button without filling required fields
Wait for validation to trigger
Assert that the form heading is still visible — validation prevented submission
assertions: Validation error messages should be visible for empty required fields
The form heading should still be visible — the form was not submitted successfully
notes: For validation tests, submit the form empty or with invalid data. Assert on error messages and the form staying visible.
